clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Vorsha the Lasher terrorizes the Horde's foothold on Ashenvale's coast. The nearby naga honor the hydra's ferocity with an offering brazier on an offshore island. Muglash plans to extinguish its flame, drawing Vorsha ashore to end her attacks.

Northwestern Ashenvale's Zoram Strand is among the most dangerous stretches of coast. Zoram'gar Outpost holds a narrow strip there, beset by hostile wildlife, night elves, and serpentine invaders. Among the strand's most destructive threats is Vorsha the Lasher, a gargantuan hydra known for brutal, unprovoked strikes against the outpost. She surges from the surf to crush its defenses and butcher its warriors, then vanishes into the deep tides.

The nearby naga venerate Vorsha's ravenous violence. On a rocky outcrop offshore, they keep an offering brazier burning in her honor. Muglash, an orc determined to end the outpost's constant harassment, has realized that defiling the ritual flame will enrage both the naga guardians and the hydra. Vorsha will surge to the surface in fury, giving the defenders a chance to draw her into an ambush instead of waiting for another surprise slaughter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Vorsha the Lasher... The fiendish hydra that roams the seas...
She has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.
But I am ready, friend. I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.
The naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.
We will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.
We are in your debt, friend.
